anticipated_failure_modes: HAR is close to saturated for strong models, so all arms may sit near the same accuracy and H3 may be decided by noise. The matched-chunks comparison and 3 seeds are there to blunt it, and if the spread across seeds exceeds the H3 tolerance that will be reported as inconclusive rather than as a pass.
The teacher's earliest-correct-chunk target may be poorly calibrated for subjects unseen in training, since the canonical split is subject-disjoint and by design a distribution shift.
Confidence-based exit is genuinely strong here and has no teacher cost. It may simply win.

dataset.human_subjects: Anonymised volunteer accelerometer/gyroscope recordings. Nonclinical. No identifiers.
dataset.inputs: 9 inertial channels x 128 timesteps per window, as shipped. No feature engineering; the 561-feature file is NOT used.
dataset.license: CC BY 4.0 per the UCI repository listing
dataset.name: UCI Human Activity Recognition Using Smartphones (Anguita et al., 2013)
dataset.split: The dataset's canonical SUBJECT-DISJOINT partition, used exactly as shipped: 21 subjects train, 9 subjects test. Within the train partition, subjects 1, 3, 5, 6 are held out as validation, chosen as the four lowest subject IDs so the choice cannot be tuned. The test partition is not read until this prediction is opened.
dataset.what_has_been_inspected_so_far: Archive structure, file names, array shapes, subject IDs and the activity label names. No label distribution, no signal values, and no model has been trained or evaluated.

halting_supervision_and_its_cost.cost_disclosure: The supervised method requires training the teacher first, so its total training cost is roughly double the baselines'. That must be reported in the results and counted against it.
halting_supervision_and_its_cost.method: The confirmed mechanism is SUPERVISED halting, and real data supplies no ground-truth halt step. The target is therefore derived from a teacher: the earliest chunk at which a fixed-depth reference model, trained on the same train split, is correct AND above 0.9 softmax confidence; if no chunk qualifies, the target is the final chunk.
halting_supervision_and_its_cost.prior_art_declared_in_advance: This is early-exit distillation and it is PRIOR ART. Deriving exit targets from a teacher's earliest correct decision is an established technique in the early-exit and early time-series classification literature. No novelty is claimed for it here.

prediction.kill_condition: If H3 fails -- confidence-based early exit matches or beats supervised halting at matched compute -- then on real data the confirmed mechanism does not beat the obvious baseline that requires no teacher, and the Q-Neuro 3.0 contribution must be restricted to tasks that supply a genuine halt target. That would be a material narrowing and must be stated as the headline, not buried.
prediction.models: One shared GRU-style recurrent core over chunk embeddings, identical for every arm. (1) fixed depth: consume all 16 chunks, classify from the final state. (2) confidence exit: same core, exit when max softmax exceeds a threshold tuned ON VALIDATION ONLY, sweeping thresholds to trace its own accuracy/compute curve. (3) supervised halting: the Q-Neuro 3.0 core -- halt on a supervised predicate, classify from the halt step. (4) ACT-style and (5) PonderNet-style halting, implemented faithfully, ponder cost swept. Matched core, matched parameter budget within 5%, matched training budget per arm, matched optimiser and schedule. 3 seeds, fixed in advance as 0, 1, 2.

predictions.H1_accuracy_matched: Supervised halting's test accuracy is within 0.02 of the fixed-depth model's, on the mean over 3 seeds, on the untouched test subjects.
predictions.H2_real_saving: Supervised halting consumes at most 60% of the 16 chunks on average.
predictions.H3_beats_the_strongest_natural_baseline: Against confidence-based early exit at MATCHED mean chunks (within 0.5 chunks, by choosing the confidence threshold whose mean chunk count is closest), supervised halting's accuracy is at least as high, allowing 0.01 tolerance. This is the clause that decides whether the mechanism earns its place on real data, because confidence exit needs no teacher and no extra training.
predictions.H4_batch1_latency: Batch-1 wall-clock speedup over fixed depth is at least 1.5x.
predictions.H5_the_ceiling_reappears: Under lockstep execution at batch 256, the wall-clock speedup over fixed depth is at most 1.3x -- the straggler ceiling must show up on real data too.

prediction.purpose: Gates 1 and 9. Every Q-Neuro 3.0 result so far is on synthetic tasks I designed. This opens a REAL dataset, on a real workload class (streaming on-device activity recognition), against the strongest natural baseline for the setting (confidence-based early exit), with the split fixed by the dataset's own canonical subject partition so I cannot choose it.

task.definition: The 128-step window is delivered in 16 chunks of 8 timesteps. The model consumes chunks in order and must emit the activity class, halting as early as it can. Variable computation is structurally justified: LAYING is separable almost immediately while WALKING_UPSTAIRS versus WALKING_DOWNSTAIRS is not.
task.name: early activity classification
task.why_this_is_a_real_workload: On-device streaming activity recognition on a phone is the batch-1, latency-sensitive, private-inference regime that QNEURO3-NICHE-P1 identified as the niche. This tests the claim where it says it should hold.
